view_frame: Front view (XZ plane) displays the wheel face with X as horizontal width and Z as vertical height. Right view (YZ plane) displays the wheel thickness with Y as depth and Z as height. The wheel is a planar solid extruded along the Y-axis.

features.section: Closed XY profile (wheel face) extruded along Z
features.placement: Centered at (0,0). Outer boundary is a circle of radius 60. Inner boundary is a circle of radius 50 (rim inner edge). Hub is a circle of radius 15. Eight spokes connect hub to rim. Extrusion depth is 8 mm along Z.
features.evidence: Front view shows concentric circles (rim and hub) and 8 radial lines (spokes). Text annotation specifies OD 120 mm and thickness 8 mm. Right view confirms uniform thickness.

connections: Spokes connect the outer rim to the central hub.
All features are part of a single connected solid.
edit_rules: Changing OD 120 mm updates the outer rim radius and spoke lengths.
Changing thickness 8 mm updates the extrusion depth.
Changing ASSUMED rim_width updates the inner rim radius.
Changing ASSUMED hub_diameter updates the hub radius and spoke inner endpoints.
Changing ASSUMED spoke_width updates the width of the 8 radial segments.
